name: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B
archDisplay: Hybrid Mamba-2 / Transformer LatentMoE, 74B total / 9B active, compressed from Nemotron 3.5 Super VL with Star Elastic architecture search and distillation; C-RADIO v4-H vision encoder; 256K-token context; native 2-bit 24GB release
note: First model in NVIDIA's edge-focused Bolt line, released October 15, 2026 with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL: a 74B-total / 9B-active hybrid LatentMoE compressed from Super VL and shipped with native 2-bit quantization so it runs in 24GB of memory, plus BF16 reference weights, under OpenMDW-1.1. A smaller Bolt E4B 4GB is scheduled for October 23 and is not in the corpus. Scores are NVIDIA's for the 24GB IQ2 build. NOT FILED: GDPVal-AA-V2 (28.47) is on a different scale from the corpus gdpval-aa column; AA-Omniscience, AA-LCR and WebArena (vision) have no matching column.
